nodes.speaker: sci
nodes.text: Dr. Okafor has rock cores to bring home. Pack them all, or save weight for crew comfort?

variants.text: Our extra science kit filled dozens of delta rock cores. Pack them all, or save weight for crew comfort?
The delta cores may hold signs of ancient life. Pack them all, or save weight for crew comfort?
We only have a few plains rocks, but they are still the first from Mars. Pack them, or save weight for comfort?

nodes.fact: Perseverance is collecting sample tubes of Mars rock for a future mission to bring them to Earth.
